title: Red Hat Security Advisory: Red Hat OpenStack Platform 17.1 (python-botocore) security update
description: A security update for Red Hat OpenStack Platform 17.1 addresses a vulnerability in the python-botocore package, which is a low-level interface for Amazon Web Services. The update distrusts eMudhra intermediate CA certificates due to security concerns identified in CVE-2026-114406. This vulnerability has been rated as having an important security impact by Red Hat Product Security.
